title: 听力挑战 · 导师学术交流

rounds.speaker: 导师
rounds.line: The experiment we designed last semester produced results that exceeded all of our expectations.
rounds.lineCn: 我们上学期设计的实验产生了超出所有人预期的结果。

grammar.name: 定语从句嵌套
grammar.note: we designed 是省略引导词的定语从句修饰 experiment;that exceeded... 是另一层定语从句修饰 results,两个从句层层嵌套。

options.text: The experimental results were better than expected.
options.feedback: 结果超出了所有人的预期,即比预想更好。

options.text: The experiment failed completely last semester.
options.feedback: 原文说结果超出预期,并非失败。

options.text: The results were never published in any journal.
options.feedback: 发表与否原文并未提到。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: What I want to know is whether the data we collected can support our hypothesis.
rounds.lineCn: 我想知道的是我们收集的数据能否支持我们的假设。

grammar.name: 名词性从句多层嵌套
grammar.note: 主语从句 What I want to know + 表语从句 whether the data can support our hypothesis,其中 the data we collected 又嵌套了一个定语从句。

options.text: He wonders if the collected data can support the hypothesis.
options.feedback: 他想知道的正是数据能否支持假设。

options.text: He wonders whether the hypothesis should be rewritten first.
options.feedback: 他问的是数据能否支持假设,不是假设是否重写。

options.text: He wonders when the data were collected.
options.feedback: 他没有询问数据的收集时间。

rounds.speaker: 导师
rounds.line: You should clarify the method that you adopted when you analyzed the samples.
rounds.lineCn: 你应该澄清分析样本时所采用的方法。

grammar.name: 定语从句 + 状语从句复合
grammar.note: that you adopted 是定语从句修饰 method;when you analyzed the samples 是时间状语从句,说明采用方法的时间背景。

options.text: The professor suggests clarifying the method of analysis.
options.feedback: 导师建议把分析样本时采用的方法讲清楚。

options.text: The professor suggests collecting new samples immediately.
options.feedback: 导师建议的是澄清方法,不是重取样本。

options.text: The professor suggests removing the method section.
options.feedback: 导师并未要求删除方法部分。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: The conclusion that we drew from these findings is that further experiments are necessary.
rounds.lineCn: 我们从这些发现中得出的结论是,还需要进一步的实验。

grammar.name: 同位语从句 + 表语从句
grammar.note: that we drew from these findings 是同位语从句说明 conclusion 的内容;is that further experiments are necessary 是表语从句。

options.text: The conclusion is that more experiments are still needed.
options.feedback: 结论正是需要开展进一步的实验。

options.text: The conclusion is that the theory has been fully proven.
options.feedback: 原文结论是需要更多实验,而非理论已完全证实。

options.text: The conclusion is that the journal has rejected the paper.
options.feedback: 期刊是否拒稿原文并未提及。
